summary: Best complementary public inputs are the CMS Exchange Public Use Files for New Jersey plan benefits, service areas, and network-file discovery; and the state employee health plan Transparency in Coverage entry point for potential negotiated-rate/network evidence. These are discovery leads, not acquired datasets. Public sources found do not by themselves establish a member’s eligibility, accumulators, or current network participation at RWJUH (CCN 310038) or Saint Peter’s (CCN 310070).

sources.title: Health Insurance Exchange Public Use Files (Exchange PUFs)
sources.geography: United States; plan and issuer records include state, county, and ZIP service-area fields. Filter New Jersey and Middlesex County where represented.
sources.period: Plan years 2014–2026; CMS page reports 2026 PUFs last imported August 4, 2026. Individual files have their own update dates.
sources.grain: Varies by file: plan variant for Benefits and Cost Sharing; plan for Plan Attributes; issuer for Service Area, Network, and Machine-readable URL; the files are not a unified facility × service × effective-date table.
useful_fields: Essential health benefits, coverage limits, and cost-sharing fields
Deductible and maximum out-of-pocket plan attributes
Issuer service areas including state, county, and ZIP
Issuer URLs for machine-readable provider-network and formulary information
observed_facts: CMS describes the PUFs as downloadable plan and issuer level information for certified QHPs and SADPs.
CMS lists 2026 Benefits and Cost Sharing, Plan Attributes, Service Area, Network, and Machine-readable URL PUFs, with update dates shown on the page.

CMS states the files generally exclude data from state-based exchanges that do not rely on the federal eligibility and enrollment platform; verify New Jersey’s representation and plan coverage before treating the PUF as complete.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Bound the pull to 2026 New Jersey individual-market QHP rows: retrieve Benefits and Cost Sharing, Plan Attributes, Service Area, Network, and Machine-readable URL PUFs from the CMS page; save the page’s linked data dictionaries and disclaimer; filter to NJ and Middlesex County/ZIPs and retain issuer, plan ID, variant, and source update date. Then use MR-PUF links only to investigate candidate provider directories; test RWJUH and Saint Peter’s facility and professional participation separately for one specified service.
limitations: Does not establish a particular patient’s eligibility, remaining deductible, or claim-level cost sharing.
Service area is not provider network participation; issuer-level network URLs may lead to current directories whose effective dates and facility-versus-professional scope need separate verification.
Availability of NJ rows and exact column names for a given plan year must be verified in the downloaded files and dictionaries.
CMS links a Data Disclaimer–User Agreement; review its terms before reuse or redistribution.

sources.title: ACA Transparency in Coverage
sources.publisher: New Jersey Division of Pensions & Benefits
sources.geography: New Jersey State Health Benefits Program and School Employees’ Health Benefits Program plans; statewide, including potential Middlesex County providers.
sources.period: Page last updated April 17, 2025; underlying public machine-readable files may have separate file dates and plan periods.
sources.grain: Transparency in Coverage files contain plan/provider/service negotiated-rate or out-of-network allowed-amount records; exact grain depends on file schema. Page directs users to search Aetna or Horizon entries for NJ DIRECT, SHBP, SEHBP, HMO, and OMNIA.
useful_fields: Provider NPI and tax identifier where present
Negotiated rate or out-of-network allowed amount
File update date and network association where included
observed_facts: The state page says its linked files contain negotiated service rates and out-of-network allowed amounts.
It identifies Aetna and Horizon file portals and instructs users to search the self-insured section for State Health Benefits Program (NJ DIRECT), SHBP, or SEHBP (HMO and OMNIA).
The source page itself was inspected, but the contents, exact file URLs, currentness, and rights terms of the linked issuer portals were not inspected; those are unverified.
sources.retrieval_next_step: For a single bounded candidate bundle, search the Aetna and Horizon portals only for one named SHBP/SEHBP plan and capture its index and plan metadata first. Identify one service code relevant to a specified simulated workflow; locate records for RWJUH and Saint Peter’s facility NPIs/TINs and separately their relevant professional NPIs. Record file dates and schema; do not infer benefit cost sharing from negotiated rates. Check the issuer terms and report any unavailable or oversized file without broad crawling.
limitations: This is a state employee plan slice, not a representative sample of NJ residents or commercial coverage generally.
Negotiated rates do not encode patient-specific eligibility, accumulators, benefit design, or guaranteed claim payment.
Facility and professional network participation can differ; provider identity matching and plan/network labeling require validation.
Exact direct download URLs, effective dates, and redistribution terms are unverified until issuer files and terms are inspected.

sources.title: Use of Pricing Information Published under the Transparency in Coverage Final Rule
sources.geography: United States; issuer/plan postings may contain New Jersey provider and service records.
sources.period: Public disclosures required beginning July 1, 2022; the CMS page was last modified October 8, 2026. Individual file periods vary.
sources.grain: In-network rate files and out-of-network allowed-amount files at covered item/service and provider-associated levels, per the applicable schema; CMS does not centrally publish these files.
useful_fields: Provider-associated in-network rates for covered items and services
Out-of-network allowed amounts and billed charges
Plan/issuer identifiers and file update date
observed_facts: CMS states most group health plans and issuers must post machine-readable files publicly, and that CMS does not actively publish the files itself.
CMS notes files can be very large and may require specific technology to download and read.
CMS recommends issuer-name web search to locate files before the October 1, 2027 home-page link requirement.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Use the state PUF’s issuer URL or the state employee plan page as a narrow discovery route. For one plan and one service only, locate the issuer’s public index, capture the index and linked file metadata, then extract records matching verified facility and professional identifiers. Do not treat the presence of a negotiated rate as evidence of member coverage.
limitations: This is a discovery and access guide, not a local dataset or direct-download endpoint.
Issuer files may be extremely large; direct URLs and actual current file contents were not verified here.
Pricing disclosures cannot substitute for a member benefit check or live eligibility response.

missing_inputs: Current plan-specific eligibility and benefit evidence, including deductible and out-of-pocket accumulators, for the synthetic members.
Verified current facility and professional network participation, effective dates, and service-specific coverage for RWJUH and Saint Peter’s across the selected plans.
A defined single service/workflow and named plan/market slice for the next bounded acquisition.
simulation_use: Use verified CMS PUF plan variants as candidate benefit-design inputs and the issuer public files as candidate provider-network/rate evidence for one narrowly specified service. Keep plan benefit, network participation, negotiated price, and patient eligibility as separate facts with independent source dates; represent unknown eligibility and accumulators as unknown. The state employee plan bundle is only an external benchmark if the intended simulated population is not specifically SHBP/SEHBP.
limitations: No files were downloaded; listing and inspection of source pages are discovery only.
No local coverage rates or costs were estimated.
The inspected sources do not guarantee exact RWJUH or Saint Peter’s matches, current facility/professional distinctions, or redistribution rights for issuer files.
